name: [UPD!] Scam With Your Friends
desc:
Scam your friends. Make money. Don’t get caught. 💸

🤑 Pull off ridiculous scams with your friends
🎭 Trick NPCs and convince them to hand over their cash
💼 Complete quests and DON'T GET CAUGHT!.
💰 Earn money and upgrade your scamming gear
🏠 Unlock new locations, tools, and opportunities [SOON]
🚨 Avoid getting raided, caught, or FIRED!

🔥 The more money you make, the crazier and riskier the scams become.

Will you make it the whole week?

👹 Take on huge high-risk scams with your crew
⚔️ Work together… or completely betray your friends
💎 Hit the jackpot and escape with the quota
🏆 Unlock exclusive classes and become the boss

📱 Playable on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console

💸 Do you have what it takes to become the ultimate scammer?

⚠️ This game is fictional and made for entertainment. Don’t scam people in real life please.

llm.loop: work in scam call center with friends -> trick NPCs into handing over cash -> complete quests while avoiding raids -> hit weekly quota -> upgrade gear/classes
llm.objectives: meet the money quota and survive the week without getting caught
llm.progression: money, scamming gear, classes, days of the week, gems
llm.instructions: pull off scams with friends, trick NPCs, complete quests, don't get caught, upgrade gear, hit the quota
unique: scam call-center office setting with co-op quota and possible betrayal
llm.thumbnails: office of scammers, PC scam screen with money counter, SWAT raid, quota 500/5000, 2 HOURS timer icon
llm.complexity_notes: office map, NPC AI, raid events, multiple tools and classes
